name: Kuraki Yuriko
source:
“—So then, Koichi-san, have you made up your mind?”

The one who oversees the Kuraki household and Suzuna’s mother.
Usually graceful and strict with an air of allure, she can at times act with a gentle, maternal warmth—as if she were an entirely different person. A woman difficult to pin down. She strongly desires for Koichi to become the head of the Kuraki family.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
